title: Chemical Equation Balancer
description: Type an unbalanced chemical equation; the program finds whole-number coefficients that conserve every element.
versionOrder: Inferred development sequence, not established dates. The 1979 family precedes Chemistry Balancer II (copyright 1981). Within each family the order follows source changes; within a capture, save order. Tape numbers alone do not establish chronology.

versions.label: 1979 · First balancer
versions.note: Floating-point Gaussian elimination; no parentheses. Rescales by reciprocal fractional parts until coefficients are whole.

versions.label: 1979 · Retry draft (test equation)
versions.note: Adds a retry path for equations with too few unknowns. The prompt is bypassed by a hard-coded borax test equation.

versions.label: 1979 · Retry draft (debugging)
versions.note: Debugging save: prints trace numbers, turns on TRON in the reduction path and stops after a result.

versions.label: 1979 · Retry draft (cleaned)
versions.note: Debug output removed and long results wrap, but subroutine line 2000 is missing.

versions.label: 1979 · Parentheses
versions.note: Adds parenthesized groups such as CA(O.H)2 and prints the arrow as -^.

versions.label: 1979 · Repeated elements
versions.note: Adds counts when an element appears more than once in a compound. Most capable 1979 version.

versions.label: 1979 · Matrix-print experiment
versions.note: Fixed 20-element arrays and a matrix printout; bypasses the dependent-row reduction.

versions.label: 1979 · Copyright 1979
versions.note: Adds the 1979 copyright remarks and two pivot fixes; still bypasses dependent-row reduction.

versions.label: II · Integer draft
versions.note: New parser and exact numerator/denominator elimination, with every variable declared integer.

versions.label: II · Mixed precision draft
versions.note: Double-precision fractions and a default test equation; partial-equation search under development.

versions.label: II · Test routines
versions.note: Revised numeric declarations and test routines.
